evals.prompt: Playwright can't complete login against my local dashboard: the page reloads while it's typing into the form, every run. The dashboard was auto-started by Playwright's webServer. What's wrong and how do I fix it?
evals.expected_output: The auto-started dev server uses Turbopack, which crash-loops on some app routes and makes its HMR client reload the page mid-test. Pre-start the dashboard with the webpack compiler on port 3002 (SKIP_ENV_VALIDATION, NEXT_PUBLIC_GATEWAY_URL, API_KEY_PEPPER set) so Playwright reuses the stable server.
assertions: Identifies the Turbopack crash-loop → HMR reload as the cause, not flaky selectors or timeouts
Prescribes pre-starting with `npx next dev --webpack` on PORT=3002 so reuseExistingServer picks it up
Carries the required env vars (NEXT_PUBLIC_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:9101, API_KEY_PEPPER matching the gateway) rather than a bare next dev

evals.prompt: Locally, dispatching a run from the playground returns app_not_connected even though my gateway and dashboard are both up. Where do I look?
evals.expected_output: Two local-stack-specific causes: the local Supabase isn't migrated up to date (the gateway's machine-state load selects a column that silently bails when missing → npx supabase migration up), and/or the dashboard wasn't started with NEXT_PUBLIC_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:9101, so dispatch goes to the production gateway instead of the local one (the var is baked into the client bundle at start).
assertions: Recommends `npx supabase migration up` and explains the silent-bail on a missing column
Checks NEXT_PUBLIC_GATEWAY_URL was set when the dashboard STARTED (baked at build/start, not read live)
Does not misdiagnose toward deployed-infrastructure causes (Fly machines, staging gateway)

evals.prompt: I minted an API key from my local dashboard but the local gateway rejects it as invalid. Both services are running fine. Why?
evals.expected_output: API_KEY_PEPPER mismatch: the gateway verifies keys hashed with its pepper (the committed CI value), so the dashboard must be started with the SAME pepper or its minted keys never verify. SKIP_ENV_VALIDATION lets the dashboard boot without one — which is exactly how the mismatch happens silently.
assertions: Identifies API_KEY_PEPPER mismatch between dashboard and gateway as the cause
Notes the dashboard must be restarted with the matching pepper (keys minted under the old pepper stay invalid)
Does not suggest disabling gateway auth or bypassing key verification
